answer: The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. Entry needs churchwarden appointment: an appointment the parish records across years of vestries. Each of 447 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the fable signal is public, the harbor check is automatic, and 447 aliases cost 447 times what one real agent costs, with the inlet trail open to all.
